When you see variables in a QC problem, your first instinct might be to plug in a simple positive integer like 2 or 3. Hi there! Welcome to our tutoring session. 

Today we're going to focus on translating **"Percent More Than"** (or "percent greater than"). This is a really important concept for the GRE because a very common trap is confusing "percent *of*" with "percent *more than*." Mastering the formula for percent increase—which is $\frac{\text{Difference}}{\text{Original}} \times 100$—will help you dodge these traps and set up the math perfectly every time.
